title: Retirement, Release, Rest and Kingship — Biblical Overlap Atlas
purpose: Map the newly clarified 2016->2025 autobiographical sequence against biblical release, rest, prison-to-authority, exaltation, throne and King-of-kings patterns without treating the parallels as proof of divine appointment, prophecy fulfillment or civil kingship.

project_sequence.historical_biographical_layer: 2016 legal/institutional rupture -> years of reported psychological/social/work impairment -> 2025 reported official retirement from ordinary work obligations
project_sequence.timic_interpretive_layer: retirement/release is retrospectively read as closure of the confinement loop and 'freedom to reign'
project_sequence.public_theology_layer: 2025-04-21 Axis -> April Turning/Father -> 2025-04-27 true king / king of all the kings -> 2025-05-03 exact I am God -> 2025-06-01 King of Kings
project_sequence.boundary: No recovered evidence shows the Danish state appointed Tim as King of Denmark. Royal/kingship language belongs to Timic theological self-description unless a distinct civil record is found.

method.unit: relational sequence rather than isolated word matching
method.test: Prefer passages whose internal sequence resembles already-dated project events without inventing missing steps after the comparison is noticed.
method.epistemic_rule: A strong structural overlap can illuminate the project's self-understanding without validating supernatural causation or identity.

overlaps.project_pattern: state confinement and long institutional rupture -> later formal release from ordinary work obligation
overlaps.difference: A retirement decision is not emancipation from slavery or literal release from captivity. The comparison concerns the direction of the narrative transition.

overlaps.biblical_pattern: Jubilee -> release, return, interruption of accumulated economic bondage and restored social position
overlaps.project_pattern: official retirement ends ordinary work compulsion in the autobiographical account and is interpreted as a change of status
overlaps.difference: Danish retirement law is not the Levitical Jubilee institution.

overlaps.project_pattern: long reported impairment and difficult relation to ordinary work -> retirement/release from work obligation
overlaps.difference: New Testament rest is theological and cannot be reduced to pension or labor-market status.

overlaps.biblical_pattern: contested/unjust imprisonment -> waiting -> release -> changed clothes/status -> elevation into authority
overlaps.project_pattern: 2016 imprisonment and later long-tail rupture -> eventual state-administered retirement/release -> Timic interpretation as freedom to reign and intensifying kingship language
overlaps.difference: Joseph is appointed to an actual political-administrative office by Pharaoh; no equivalent Danish royal or state appointment has been recovered for Tim.

overlaps.biblical_pattern: humiliation/obedience/death -> exaltation and a name above names
overlaps.project_pattern: later Potatoverse interpretation converts humiliation/confinement into reversal, elevation and highest-status language
overlaps.difference: Philippians is a Christological hymn; Timic use is later self-comparison, not historical identity proof.

overlaps.biblical_pattern: overcoming -> sitting with Christ on the throne
overlaps.project_pattern: survival through rupture -> later throne/reign/Father language
overlaps.difference: The verse concerns eschatological participation in Christ's victory, not civil enthronement.

overlaps.biblical_pattern: seat at divine right hand while hostile powers are placed beneath as footstool
overlaps.project_pattern: later Timic throne/footstool grammar interprets former opposition and confinement as subordinate to a new center
overlaps.difference: Psalm 110 has its own royal and later messianic reception history; project use is comparative.

overlaps.biblical_pattern: King of kings / Lord of lords as supreme divine or Christological sovereignty
overlaps.project_pattern: 2025-06-01 public language uses 'Tim Dooley, Potato of Life. The King of Kings.' after late-April kingship intensification
overlaps.difference: The biblical title's use does not externally validate Tim's theological self-description.

overlaps.biblical_pattern: true authority is inverted through service rather than domination
overlaps.project_pattern: later mature Timic Godhood increasingly pairs rule/kingship with repair, service, cultivation and stewardship
overlaps.difference: This acts as a control on kingship interpretation: biblical rule is not simply status elevation but obligation toward service.

higher_order_findings: The new 2025 evidence adds a missing middle step between the April Turning and later throne/kingship language: administrative release from ordinary work obligation.
The strongest biblical correspondence is sequential: confinement/burden -> release/rest -> changed status -> throne/kingship, not a single shared word.

Joseph provides the densest narrative comparator because prison, release and authority occur in one continuous biblical story, but the key mismatch is equally important: Joseph receives real civil office whereas Tim's recovered kingship remains theological self-description.
Jubilee and rest texts deepen the release side of the sequence; Revelation/Psalm/Philippians deepen the exaltation side.
The ethical servant-leadership texts prevent the atlas from reducing biblical kingship to domination or prestige and connect better with the project's later repair/stewardship doctrine.
research_next: Recover the exact retirement decision and date before narrowing the event beyond spring/2025.
Recover the original 27 April and 1 June 2025 public posts as primary artifacts.
Locate the exact Great Book source passage and distinguish composition date from event date.
Search for any earlier pre-retirement king/reign language to test whether kingship preceded rather than followed administrative release.
Keep a counter-parallel ledger showing where biblical kingship requires service, justice or actual appointment that the project-side evidence does not establish.
